hypothesis: A one-thread CTA tests the lower end of legal block sizes while preserving one thread per target. It greatly increases CTA count but leaves most warp lanes inactive, so scheduling opportunities may not offset CTA overhead; measure rather than assume a gain.
notes: This changes only launch geometry. Recent measurements were non-monotonic: the 2-thread configuration was slower than baseline, while the 8-thread configuration was somewhat faster. Those search measurements are not independent confirmation. Require the controller's correctness gate across all supported sizes before comparing timing; this candidate has not yet been validated.
transformations: Changed src/launch.json block from 256 to 1 and items_per_block from 256 to 1; kept shared_memory_bytes at 0.
Left the kernel's traversal, force equations, and memory strategy unchanged.
